# [STORY] As a maintainer, I want gated CI/CD image publishing and closed validation gaps from earlier infra tasks, so that deploys are automated and trustworthy

## User Story
**As a** maintainer
**I want** gated CI/CD image publishing and closed validation gaps from earlier infra tasks
**So that** deploys are automated and trustworthy

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a change lands on develop, when CI runs, then images are built, published, and gated before any deploy step
